question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The irrational fear of snakes
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ophidiophobia"** refers to the irrational fear of snakes. (सांपों का असामान्य डर)

 
 
• **Example:** Due to her ophidiophobia, she avoids hiking trails known to have snakes.
 
 
 
• **"Fear" **is a distressing emotion aroused by perceived danger or threat, and ophidiophobia is a specific type of fear related to snakes. (डर)
 
 
• **Example:** His fear of heights makes him avoid tall buildings.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Ophidiophobia" precisely describes the irrational fear of snakes.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Xenophobia** (विदेशियों का डर): Fear or dislike of people from other countries or cultures.

 
 
• **Example:** His xenophobia prevents him from traveling abroad.
 
 
 
• **Necrophobia** (मृतकों या मृत्यु का डर): Fear of death or dead things.
 
 
• **Example:** Her necrophobia made her extremely uncomfortable at funerals.
 
 
 
• **Nomophobia** (मोबाइल फोन से दूर रहने का डर): Fear of being without a mobile phone or losing signal.
 
 
• **Example:** His nomophobia makes him carry a portable charger everywhere.
